name: Claude in Slack
summary: Mention Claude in a Slack channel with a coding task and get a cloud session and a pull request.
what: When you @mention Claude in Slack with a coding request, it starts a Claude Code cloud session, posts progress in the thread and links the session and pull request. Team and Enterprise organizations use Claude Tag, the newer Slack integration.

impact.title: Work from the conversation
impact.detail: Turn a bug report in a channel into a fix.

impact.title: Progress in the thread
impact.detail: Everyone sees updates where the request was made.

howItWorks: An admin installs the Claude app from the Slack App Marketplace.
Each person connects their Claude account in the app's home tab.
Connect GitHub and a repository at claude.ai/code.
Invite the bot to a channel and mention it with your task.

events.note: First changelog mention of Claude in Slack sessions.
